title: Production coupling storage-ownership contract audit
positive_findings: F-GC40 explicitly calls u a coupling/storage response coefficient and constructs q_u(H)=q_ref+(u/dt)*(H-H_ref).
F-GC33 maps the response algebraically to MODFLOW API HCOF/RHS with HCOF=A*u/dt_day.
The application service owns coupled iteration, residual evaluation, reanchoring and transaction ordering, not MODFLOW model construction.
The API binding publishes NODELIST/HCOF/RHS only; it does not own MODFLOW STO package configuration.
absent_from_audited_contract: no declared physical partition of shared groundwater storage between SWAP and MODFLOW
no specific-yield or specific-storage field in the coupling response/application contract
no check that MODFLOW STO Sy/Ss excludes storage already represented by the SWAP response
no check that MODFLOW STO Sy/Ss deliberately includes or matches a declared shared combined-storage relation
no production invariant that relates u to MODFLOW Sy/Ss for the same physical volume
supporting_research: DSW02 shows that one physical storage can be partitioned consistently and that duplicate counting has a predictable signature.
MAP03/E4 show that, in a simple real-Richards family, u locally matches finite-window whole-column dS/dH and bottom-outward exchange has sensitivity -u.
MAP10 shows that this real-SWAP u is strongly window-dependent and therefore is not a universal static specific yield.
The F-GC45 fixture independently configures MODFLOW STO with Sy=0.15 and Ss=0.02 1/m; those fixture values are not bound by the coupling contract to the SWAP u response.
bounded_conclusion: The current production coupling contract specifies how a SWAP response is represented in MODFLOW but does not explicitly specify or enforce physical storage ownership relative to MODFLOW STO. This is an architecture/contract gap. It is not by itself evidence that the current production model double-counts storage, because u is a finite-window response and physical overlap between the configured SWAP and MODFLOW storage volumes has not yet been established equation by equation.
required_next_questions: What physical control volume is represented by MODFLOW Sy/Ss in a coupled cell?
What part of that same control volume, if any, is included in the SWAP finite-window dS/dH response?
Should the accepted shared-state equation use S_MODFLOW + S_SWAP, S_MODFLOW only with SWAP flux excluding storage, or another explicitly derived partition?
How should this ownership be configured and validated in the eventual product driver?
forbidden_inference: do not call current production coupling double-counted solely from the coexistence of u and MODFLOW STO
do not set MODFLOW Sy/Ss to zero without a physical-domain derivation
do not treat u_A as a static Sy
do not modify production coupling until a shared-volume ownership experiment is prospectively defined and qualified
